# Partiful — account brief

## Who
Partiful is a party invite product; its homepage reads "Partiful — Delightful, free party invites. Plan events and parties with friends." ([source](https://partiful.com/)) Its GitHub org profile lists partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful)), and a second org profile under `partiful-app` lists the same site ([source](https://github.com/partiful-app)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is present in `partiful/mobile` ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- A second `eas.json` sits in `partiful-app/mobile-legacy` ([source](https://github.com/partiful-app/mobile-legacy/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `partiful/mobile/package.json` pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- `partiful/mobile` last pushed 2026-08-14 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile)).
- The org has 12 public repos and 180 followers ([source](https://github.com/partiful)).
- The App Store listing has 41,200 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)) and 6 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)).
- An open issue reads "eas update rollout stuck at 0% for Android channel" ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)).
- Partiful links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://partiful.com/careers)).

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@partiful-maintainer-1), 142 commits, top contributor to `partiful/mobile` ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Partiful", location "Remote", website https://partiful.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at Partiful. Maintains the Partiful app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@partiful-maintainer-2), 87 commits ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Partiful", location "New York, NY", website https://partiful.com, and bio "React Native developer on the Partiful mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the Partiful app." ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2))
- Maintainer Three (@partiful-maintainer-3), 31 commits ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Partiful", location "San Francisco, CA", website https://partiful.com, and bio "Engineer at Partiful. Mostly the Partiful app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3))

## Why now
The repo pushed as recently as 2026-08-14 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile)) and the App Store listing shows 6 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). The app is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
Maintainer One, your profile says you maintain the Partiful app on Expo and React Native ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)), and `partiful/mobile` shipped a push on 2026-08-14 against 6 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile), [source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). I also saw an open issue in the repo titled "eas update rollout stuck at 0% for Android channel" ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)). At that release cadence, how do you currently tell a stalled Android update rollout apart from one that is simply still propagating?
